title: Blender pipeline
summary: Models as Python, built by headless Blender: palette shading (one shared material), detail shapes (lathe, extrude, planks, bands, rivets, rocks, crystals), glow, jointed parts for animation, contact-sheet previews with a player-size figure; live Blender (MCP) and hand-made files documented. Needs model-import
claude_md: - Scripted models: `tools/blender/build.sh <name> --preview`, then look at the sheet.
